description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

IBM develops AI-powered, cloud-native software and technology solutions. The Software Developer designs, develops, tests, and delivers software offerings, collaborates with stakeholders in an Agile environment, fixes customer-reported issues, and contributes to CI/CD pipelines.
Software Developer designing, coding, and unit-testing component solutions and customer fixes, while contributing to automated CI/CD delivery.

Responsibilities:
• Design, code, and test component-level software solutions, ensuring they are unit tested and ready for integration into products
• Work in an Agile environment to understand stakeholder requirements and deliver solutions that meet their needs
• Design, develop, and unit test code fixes for customer-reported problems
• Participate in the development of an automated CI/CD pipeline that takes code through various quality stages
• Test and deliver offerings using leading-edge and/or proven technologies

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Familiarity with designing, developing, testing, and delivering back-end components of software applications using leading-edge and/or proven technologies
• Understanding of Agile principles and practices, with experience working in a collaborative environment to understand stakeholder requirements
• Knowledge of designing, coding, and testing component-level software solutions, ensuring they are unit tested and ready for integration into products
• Exposure to debugging customer-reported problems, designing, developing, and unit testing code fixes
• Familiarity with contributing to the development of automated CI/CD pipelines that take code through various quality stages
• IBM will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship

Preferred:
• Master's Degree
• Exposure to designing, developing, testing, and delivering front-end components of software applications using leading-edge and/or proven technologies
• Familiarity with DevOps engineering practices and tools, contributing to the development of automated CI/CD pipelines
• Exposure to L3 support engineering, debugging customer-reported problems, and designing, developing, and unit testing code fixes
